The game has huge potential, it is fun to play, and the graphics and animations are very good. That is where the positives end. Now the problems:

There are too many bugs. For example, crashes and disconnects from the game at the most critical moments. Dinosaur controls can simply stop working, and you just stand there helplessly like free food.

The dumbest thing is this: you lie down to sleep, which is supposed to be a safe logout with progress saved. Then you log back in, and your dinosaur is gone! I had just spent 8 hours growing a Tyrannosaurus. First, the server crashed, and when I returned to the game, the Rex had simply disappeared! I wasted half of my day off for nothing.

High ping is another issue. During chases or fights, unexpected teleporting happens, or attacks and jumps do not register. This can cost your dinosaur its life.

There are also cheaters. They exist in every game, but here it is a real problem. Once again, you play as a large dinosaur, grow for many hours, and then a small dinosaur kills you in one hit. So all that is left is to play as a small dinosaur and watch other people play as large ones.

And I honestly do not understand how people manage to grow Prime Deinosuchus or Rexes. Either they have nerves of steel and a lot of free time, or they are cheaters who instantly get adult dinosaurs.

The game has been in development for 10 years, but instead of fixing the bugs, the studio keeps adding new dinosaurs.

There is also an in-game problem with the Discord community. For example: you spend 8 hours growing a Deinosuchus, then a small Rex runs past you, reports your location on Discord, and five minutes later adult Deinosuchus come for you and eat you. The same thing happens with Rexes.

Conclusion: the game is interesting, but it is impossible to play. IMHO.
